content.title: Personal Statement
content.content: Motivated software development student with experience in programming, embedded systems, and full-stack development through both academic study and personal projects. Experienced developing applications using Python, C#, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and C++, with a particular interest in object-oriented programming, APIs, and hardware-integrated software systems. Currently completing a software development placement at QinetiQ while independently developing Raspberry Pi and ESP32-based projects.
